name: Emberwake
tagline: A first-person, retro pixel-3D adventure. Clear nine dungeons, collect eight Ember Shards, unmake the Hollow King.
controls: WASD move, mouse look, click or Space attack, right-click or E item, M map, Esc menu. Gamepads work too.
howToJoin: Host opens Menu, then Invite Friends, which shows a 5-character code.
Friends pick Join a Friend and type the code, or open the invite link.
If the code won't connect, everyone joins the same hotspot or Wi-Fi and uses the webcam QR option on both sides.
author: MLMecham

name: Dot Slayer
tagline: Fast browser arena game with room-code co-op for up to four players. Plays on phones too.
howToJoin: Host starts a room and gets a room code.
Friends open the game and enter the code.
author: Logan-Lay21

name: Own The Night
tagline: Night-time 3D street racing. Eight cars, four neighborhoods, five weather settings, handbrake drifts and competitive AI.
controls: WASD or arrows to drive, Space handbrake, Shift nitro, P autopilot, R recover to last checkpoint, Esc pause.
howToJoin: LAN multiplayer is coming soon to the hosted version.
For now, the host downloads the repo from GitHub and runs npm start (needs Node.js), then shares the network address it prints.
Everyone on the same Wi-Fi opens that address, picks LAN MULTIPLAYER, and creates or joins a room. Up to six racers, with AI filling empty seats.
author: Soroosh-N
